141: unless he is a heavy-set person... The same applies if one is ill or very old, such that is is difficult for them to stand without support. But they should be careful to only lean a little, and not to lean so much that they would fall if the thing they lean upon were to be removed. And if it is not possible for them to lean in this way and they require assistance to support themselves, this too is permitted. Only one should not rest upon the cloth that is over table as it is a holiness-adjacent object, rather, upon the table itself.
